Watch for pullbacks in laggards like ADBE and ACN for entry points, given structural demand from Indonesia's growing digital economy.

Commodity price volatility and regulatory shifts (e.g., sugar taxes) create margin pressure, rewarding firms with vertical integration and cost-efficient supply chains.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's consumer & FMCG sector underperformed (-0.80% agg, -1.60% ID) vs US (+1.48%), signaling a WATCH. Key movers like AGAR (+24.75%) and KLIN (+10.00%) suggest selective momentum in smaller caps, but broad weakness warrants caution. Focus on high-growth subsegments like specialty foods and personal care, while avoiding broad exposure until domestic demand strengthens.

Use this divergence to rotate from ID developers into US-listed REITs for better liquidity and yield stability.
